description: This file defines data models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for comparing groups using Finviz data within a financial analysis project. It includes classes for query parameters, data representation, and methods for data extraction and transformation.

classes.name: FinvizCompareGroupsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Finviz group comparison, including group and metric choices.

classes.name: FinvizCompareGroupsData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for a Finviz compare group, including various financial metrics and properties.

classes.name: FinvizCompareGroupsFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and processing of Finviz compare group data based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a FinvizCompareGroupsQueryParams object, setting defaults if necessary.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches raw data from Finviz based on query parameters, using finvizfinance library, and returns a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into FinvizCompareGroupsData model instances.
